d:
Some memories linger like the fragrance of attar Presenting Itra’n Di Sheeshi (ਾਂ ੀ ਼ੀ਼ੀ), written, composed and sung by Dr. Satinder Sartaaj, from his album Travel Diaries, Part 1: Musafir, with music by Beat Minister.
Sartaaj’s poetry and soulful voice turn a simple sheeshi of itar into a song about love, memories and the journeys of the heart
Album - Travel Diaries
Part 1 - Musafir
Song - ਾਂ ੀ ਼ੀ਼ੀ Itra’n Di Sheeshi (Official Video)
Singer | Lyrics | Composer - Satinder Sartaaj
Music - Beat Minister
Editor - Garry Rajowal
